pages.text: Use the wooden side of the box with a cargo cover to install it fully spread. Both forms are supported. Choose either a cover or a canopy.$(br2)Use cloth or its roll to uncover one row, front to rear. Sneak-use cloth or the roll to spread one row.

Roll back the cloth to expose cargo for use, loading or unloading. You can also open the tailgate for rear access. Spread cloth supports standing entities.$(br2)Sneak-use a fully rolled cover to spread it again. To remove the whole cover, sneak-use the $(bold)exposed wooden sideboard$(reset).

pages.text: All wool must match. Corners accept leads or vines; wool determines the colour.
Light grey cover: spread / two rows rolled.
